lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing the silver threads of a loom buried in stone
Where the whispers of the cosmos find a house to call home
I weave the heavy shadows into a fabric of light
Chasing the ghosts of the morning into the cradle of night
Every stitch is a secret, a map of the hidden land
Crafted by the motion of a steady, unseen hand
Mountains fold like paper in the furnace of the sun
While the race of the spirit is tirelessly, quietly run
[Chorus]
Spinning the thread of the infinite wheel
Turning the clay into something real
Between the first breath and the final spark
Weaving the light through the hollows of dark
[Verse]
The weaver watches seasons turn like pages in a book
Catching every fleeting glance and every deliberate look
One strand for the sorrow, one for the steady grace
Finding the rhythm of the pulse in the center of space
Gravity pulls the anchor while the dreams begin to fly
Painting the same colors on a different shade of sky
The pattern is complex, a labyrinth of gold and grey
Mapping the path of the soul as it wanders away
[Chorus]
Spinning the thread of the infinite wheel
Turning the clay into something real
Between the first breath and the final spark
Weaving the light through the hollows of dark
[Bridge]
From the dust of the stars to the marrow of bone
We carve out a kingdom to call our own
[Chorus]
Spinning the thread of the infinite wheel
Turning the clay into something real
Between the first breath and the final spark
Weaving the light through the hollows of dark
[Outro]
